definitions.full: H1445. Geder גֶּ֫דֶר proper name, of a location Canaanitish city Josh 12:13 . Γαδερ A & ᵐ5 L also Euseb Lag Onom. 244 2nd ed. 254 = גָּדֵר ? Lag BN 76 ; compare גְּדֵרִי below; possibly = גָּדֵר בֵּית 1Chr 2:51 .
